## alice-mail-attachment-processor (PROJ-53 Iteration 4)

Nightly (02:00) drain of the Redis list `alice:mail:attachment_queue`, which
`alice-mail-sync` fills minutely via `Code: Enqueue Attachment Jobs`.

The attachment pipeline (prefilter -> extension routing -> PDF text ->
LLM classification -> `/attachment` fetch -> NAS write) was moved here 1:1 from
`alice-mail-sync`s former `Code: Import Attachments`, because alice-mail-sync runs
every minute and must not load the DMS model (`OLLAMA_MODEL_DMS`) while the chat
model occupies the GPU.

Queue entries are only removed after they have been handled, so a time-limit abort
or a crash leaves the rest for the next run (same pattern as `alice-dms-processor`
with `alice:dms:plaintext`).

**GPU lock (BUG-17):** acquires the project-wide `alice:dms:processor:lock:run`,
shared with `alice-dms-processor` and the DMS/mail backfills, so GPU classification
is serialised across workflows. This workflow shares the identical `0 2 * * *`
trigger with `alice-dms-processor`, so without the lock both would classify at the
same time. If the lock is busy the run skips cleanly and the queue is retried the
next night. The lock is renewed per item in `Code: Time Check` (TTL 30 min << 4 h
runtime, so a crash cannot deadlock it) and released on every terminal path.

**No MQTT publish here (BUG-16):** the mail`s own thumbnail trigger stays in
`alice-mail-sync`; attachment files get their thumbnail via the regular DMS
pipeline (scanner -> processor -> thumbnailer) after being written to
`/mnt/nas/ai/<folder>/`.
